title: Fix ChatToolCatalog.BuildTools CCN 116 - decompose monolithic method
description:
## Source
Audit swarm finding F-AG5-09 / F35 (memorysmith-staticanalysis2-audit-26-07-14-23-38-09)

## Problem
`ChatToolCatalog.BuildTools` has cyclomatic complexity 116 (841 lines in one method) — 8x lizard's default threshold. This is the most complex method in the codebase. A single unit of code review / diff conflict / edit surface.

## Severity
Medium

## Files
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatToolCatalog.cs` line 138 (BuildTools method)

## Recommendation
Split into category-scoped private methods (search/memory/task/page/code-search) composed via `.Concat()`. Pure structural refactor.

## Existing Coverage
No existing task. Related to TSK-0192 (tool-surface modularization, Backlog).
